messages.subject: R/qtl version 1.28-19
parts:
A new version of R/qtl (1.28-19) has been released at its web site
(http://www.rqtl.org) and will be on CRAN shortly.

There are three main changes: added a cross type "haploid"; added a
'crosstype' argument to read.cross, to force a particular cross type;
and revised parallel processing code to use the standard parallel
library.

See http://www.rqtl.org/STATUS.txt for a complete list of changes.

Karl Broman
